text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tenno Sho (Spring). The 
crowd buzzed with excitement over the 
showdown between Seiun Sky and Special 
Week.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky looks unusually serious. Though 
a bit shy at her Trainer's cheering, she 
deepens her concentration.
